Find the $x^2$ and $x^3$ terms in the binomial expansion of $(1 - 2x)^5$:
$$\text{Term in } x^2:\quad \binom{5}{2}(1)^3(-2x)^2 = 10(4x^2) = 40x^2$$
$$\text{Term in } x^3:\quad \binom{5}{3}(1)^2(-2x)^3 = 10(-8x^3) = -80x^3$$

Identify the products from $(1 + kx)(1 - 2x)^5$ that produce an $x^3$ term:
$$1 \times (-80x^3) = -80x^3$$
$$kx \times (40x^2) = 40kx^3$$

Equate the combined coefficient of $x^3$ to $20$:
$$40k - 80 = 20$$
